name: What is the process for starting a kitchen refresh with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a kitchen refresh with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, budget, and the specific needs of the foreclosed property's kitchen. We then provide a detailed proposal and scope of work. Upon agreement, our team handles material procurement, scheduling, and efficient project execution. We maintain open communication throughout, ensuring the project stays on track and meets your expectations, culminating in a final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with a consultation, followed by a proposal, material procurement, project execution, and a final walkthrough.
